name: Sandbox Tools
author: wolfsdk
description: Sandbox hotkeys without the 34-command console limit. Bind them once in the console (binds are saved): bind F6 "resourceExec snapdemo.cfg -s"  and  bind F7 "resourceExec snapedit.cfg -s". F6 toggles God mode, Notarget and infinite ammo; F7 kills all enemies (killMonsters). Uses two unused SnapMap configs (snapdemo.cfg, snapedit.cfg). God and infinite ammo are confirmed in game; Notarget did not stop enemies that were already fighting you in our test; killMonsters is not yet confirmed in game.
